summary: iter-443 — Prescription (Rx) auto-approval + submit-phase2 signature gate. Backend: 7/7 pytest green (test_iter443_prescription_autoapprove.py). Validated the previously-unverified critical paths: (a) submit-phase2 400 when drafted Rx has drugs but no creator signature ('Please sign the prescription before submitting Phase 2...'); (b) submit-phase2 by student with signed Rx flips Rx.status 'draft'->'pending' and stamps submitted_at while case moves to pending_phase2; (c) dual-approve path (supervisor approve, then in-charge approve) brings case to phase2_approved AND auto-flips pending Rx to approved + stamps approved_by + locks (subsequent PUT returns 400); (d) in-charge SUBMITS Phase 2 on an IC-self-created case with a creator-signed Rx -> case lands straight in phase2_approved with Rx auto-approved + IC in approved_by, in a single call; (e) GET /prescription/pdf returns a valid application/pdf (>2 KB, '%PDF-' magic) and 400 when the case has no drugs; (f) non-stakeholder student PUT on another case's Rx is rejected (403/404). Frontend smoke on /procedures/submit-phase2/{id} (mobile 390x844, student login): prescription-section renders; rx-use-template-btn in the empty state applies the standard 4-drug template (Augmentin 625 / Ibuprofen 400 / Paracetamol 500 / Chlorhexidine 0.2% mouthwash); rx-save-btn and rx-open-sign-btn present; case detail (/procedures/{id}) shows prescription-section + rx-download-btn. Pre-existing (not Rx-related): generic console warnings 'shadow* deprecated', 'props.pointerEvents deprecated', and a 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' warning appearing on dashboard before Rx is loaded.

react_native_issues.issue: Console error 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' appears on dashboard and case screens — pre-existing stray whitespace outside a <Text> component. Not introduced by Rx feature. Reference: observed on /dashboard and /procedures/{id}.

action_items: No functional action required for the Rx feature — the previously-unverified auto-approval + signature-gate paths are all working end-to-end.
(Optional, non-blocking) Hunt the stray text node that triggers the global 'Unexpected text node' warning (not Rx code).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py submit_phase2 (lines 16885-16898): correctly blocks when drafted Rx has drugs but no creator signature; branches between rx_mark_approved (IC-self-approve path) and rx_mark_pending (student path) based on update_data['status'].

server.py approve handler at lines 16319-16329 (in-charge self-created) and 16360-16368 (both reviewers): invokes _rx.rx_mark_approved on the pending Rx when the Phase 2 transition completes — verified by T3/T4.
server.py save_prescription (16597-16603): 400 when existing Rx status=='approved', 403 when neither creator window nor faculty window matches — covered by lock test and non-stakeholder test.
prescription.py rx_mark_approved: idempotent per-id (approved_by dedup by id). PDF builder renders creator+supervisor signatures and the digitally-approved footer with SHA-256 truncation.
PrescriptionEditor.tsx: rx-use-template-btn is intentionally scoped to the empty-state (drugs.length===0). After template application the standard 4-drug set is populated correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on smoke (prescription-section + template + save/sign + download rendered)
